title: Alibaba Claims Viral Happy Horse AI Model in Latest Breakthrough
raw_excerpt: The Happy Horse video AI model that sent ripples across China's AI industry this week was created by Alibaba. The model hit the top spot on the text-to-video leaderboard of Artificial Analysis this week. Alibaba plans to provide API access to the model in the near future.
summary: 阿里巴巴低调发布的视频AI模型“Happy Horse”本周登顶Artificial Analysis文生视频排行榜，引发行业震动。该模型在多项指标上超越竞品，阿里巴巴计划近期开放API。这标志着中国AI在视频生成领域取得重大突破，竞争格局或将重塑。

title: ChatGPT $100 Pro Plan Introduced
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduced a new $100/month ChatGPT Pro tier aimed at power users, expanding its pricing lineup between the $20 Plus and $200 Pro plans. The company confirmed the $200 plan still exists despite not being listed on the pricing page.
summary: OpenAI推出每月100美元的ChatGPT Pro新套餐，定位在20美元Plus和200美元Pro之间，面向高需求用户。此举旨在满足开发者对Codex等工具的使用限制，同时扩大收入来源。OpenAI确认200美元套餐仍存在，但未在定价页列出。

title: OpenAI backs Illinois bill that would limit when AI labs can be held liable
summary: OpenAI支持伊利诺伊州一项法案，该法案旨在限制AI实验室在特定情况下的法律责任。此举引发争议，批评者认为这可能削弱对AI风险的问责。该法案若通过，将影响AI行业的责任界定和监管走向。

summary: 美国财政部和美联储召集大型银行CEO，讨论Anthropic最新AI模型Mythos可能带来的网络安全风险。政府担忧该模型能力可能被用于攻击金融系统，此举表明AI安全已上升至国家金融监管层面。

title: Sequential KV Cache Compression via Probabilistic Language Tries: Beyond the Per-Vector Shannon Limit
raw_excerpt:
作者: Gregory Magarshak
摘要: Recent work on KV cache quantization, culminating in TurboQuant, has approached the Shannon entropy limit for per-vector compression of transformer key-value caches. We observe that this limit applies to a strictly weaker problem than the one that actually matters: compressing the KV cache as a sequence. The tokens stored in a KV cache are not arbitrary floating-point data -- they are samples from the exact formal language the model was trained on, and the model is by construction a near-optimal predictor of that language. We introduce sequential KV compression, a two-layer architecture that exploits this structure. The first layer, probabilistic prefix deduplication, identifies semantically equivalent shared prefixes across sessions using the trie metric d_T(s, s') = -log_2 P_M(s ^ s') from Probabilistic Language Tries (PLTs). The second layer, predictive delta coding, stores only the residual of each new KV vector from the model's own prediction of it, achieving a per-token entropy bound of H(KV_{i+1} | KV_{<=i}) <= H(token_{i+1} | token_{<=i}). We prove that at typical language model perplexity -- approximately 10-20 for fluent English text -- this bound is 3.3-4.3 bits on average per token position, compared to TurboQuant's 3 bits per vector component (with typical attention heads having 64-128 components). The theoretical compression ratio over TurboQuant is approximately 914,000x at the Shannon limit. Even at 1000x above the entropy floor -- a…
summary: 该研究提出顺序KV缓存压缩方法，利用语言模型自身的预测能力，突破传统逐向量压缩的香农极限。通过将KV缓存视为序列而非独立向量，实现更高效的压缩，有望大幅降低Transformer推理时的显存占用。

title: HealthAdminBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Healthcare Administration Tasks
raw_excerpt:
作者: Suhana Bedi, Ryan Welch, Ethan Steinberg, Michael Wornow, Taeil Matthew Kim, Haroun Ahmed, Peter Sterling, Bravim Purohit, Qurat Akram, Angelic Acosta, Esther Nubla, Pritika Sharma, Michael A. Pfeffer, Sanmi Koyejo, Nigam H. Shah
摘要: Healthcare administration accounts for over $1 trillion in annual spending, making it a promising target for LLM-based computer-use agents (CUAs). While clinical applications of LLMs have received significant attention, no benchmark exists for evaluating CUAs on end-to-end administrative workflows. To address this gap, we introduce HealthAdminBench, a benchmark comprising four realistic GUI environments: an EHR, two payer portals, and a fax system, and 135 expert-defined tasks spanning three administrative task types: Prior Authorization, Appeals and Denials Management, and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Order Processing. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained, verifiable subtasks, yielding 1,698 evaluation points. We evaluate seven agent configurations under multiple prompting and observation settings and find that, despite strong subtask performance, end-to-end reliability remains low: the best-performing agent (Claude Opus 4.6 CUA) achieves only 36.3 percent task success, while GPT-5.4 CUA attains the highest subtask success rate (82.8 percent). These results reveal a substantial gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of real-world administrative workflows. HealthAdminBench provides a rigorous foundation for evaluating…
summary: 斯坦福等机构推出HealthAdminBench，首个评估LLM计算机使用代理在医疗管理任务上表现的基准。涵盖端到端行政工作流，填补了临床之外的评估空白。鉴于医疗行政年支出超1万亿美元，该基准对AI落地医疗具有重要指导意义。

title: Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models with Sentence Transformers
raw_excerpt: The v5.4 update of Sentence Transformers introduces multimodal embedding and reranker models that enable encoding and comparing texts, images, audio, and videos within a shared embedding space for tasks like cross-modal search and retrieval-augmented generation. These advanced models map different modalities into a consistent embedding space and assess relevance across mixed-modality pairs, though lower cross-modal similarity scores may occur due to modality clustering. Notably, multimodal rerankers provide high-quality scoring by evaluating individual pairs for more accurate retrieval results.
summary: Sentence Transformers v5.4发布，引入多模态嵌入和重排序模型，支持文本、图像、音频、视频在统一语义空间中的编码与比较。该更新使跨模态搜索和检索增强生成更加便捷，多模态重排序器可提供更精准的检索结果。

title: Anthropic launches advisor tool for Claude Platform API users
raw_excerpt: The new advisor tool on Anthropic's Claude Platform API provides developers with the ability to use Opus as an advisor alongside Sonnet or Haiku as executors. This allows agents to access advanced reasoning capabilities while maintaining operational costs at the level of the more efficient executor models. The advisor tool is now publicly available through a configuration in the Messages API request.
summary: Anthropic为Claude平台API推出顾问工具，允许开发者将Opus作为顾问与Sonnet或Haiku执行器搭配使用。该模式在保持低成本的同时获得高级推理能力，现已通过Messages API配置公开可用，有望提升Agent系统的效率。

title: Efficient Rollout Scaling for Diffusion RL
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA's Sol-RL introduces a two-stage framework that separates exploration and training, using FP4 rollouts to generate large candidate sets and BF16 for selective policy updates. This approach reduced compute costs while improving alignment and accelerating convergence in diffusion model post-training.
summary: NVIDIA提出Sol-RL框架，将扩散模型强化学习中的探索与训练分离：使用FP4精度生成大量候选，再用BF16进行选择性策略更新。该方法大幅降低计算成本，同时提升对齐效果和收敛速度，为扩散模型后训练提供了高效方案。
